text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P-2026-9001 - elevated 5xx/timeouts observed across public inference gateway (us-west-2). Start: 16:10 UTC. Impact: failed generations and increased latency.

maya: paging oncall — I'm here. seeing lots of 429s then a wave of 502/504 around 16:12.

devon: joining. quick dashboard: spike in rate limit responses at 16:11, then gateway 502s follow at 16:13.

sre-lina: pulling logs and trace ids. suspicion: quota service started rejecting traffic (429) and gateway turned failures into 502s when quota client timed out.

infra-raj: I just noticed a config push to "global-quota" via CD at 16:09 that set an aggressive default cap. That change targeted a canary but the label was wrong and it hit prod.

maya: can we revert that config? who owns the deploy?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: config-push/global-quota by infra-raj at 16:09 UTC. CI -> OK.

infra-raj: reverting now. `kubectl apply -f /manifests/quota/global-quota-prod-revert.yaml -n prod`

sre-lina: while rollback is in flight, we should short-circuit quota checks for high-tier API keys to reduce downstream fanout. I can add a temporary gateway rule.

product-olivia: agree, but warn CS/Enterprise: this bypass will let some requests through that would normally be limited. CS, is that okay?

cs-owen: CS OK with temporary bypass, prefer fewer 502s for paying customers. We'll notify impacted accounts.

devon: adding bypass rule on gateway (hotpatch):
```
# gateway hotpatch fragment
routes:
  - match: /v1/*
    if: api_key in enterprise_keys
    quota: bypass
```

incident-bot: Change applied: gateway hotpatch at 16:15 UTC by devon.

infra-raj: revert applied; quota-service reports config back to previous values. health checks: PASS.

maya: monitoring graphs: 429s drop sharply after revert; 502/504 tailing off as gateway connections drain. still seeing occasional timeouts from quota-client.

sre-lina: tailing gateway logs to confirm no new 502s. also increasing quota-client connect timeout to fail-fast to prevent long blocking.

devon: command run: `kubectl set env deployment/gateway QUOTA_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_MS=200 --namespace=prod`

product-olivia: putting brief note on status: "Partial errors affecting inference requests in us-west-2 between 16:10-16:20 UTC. Mitigation in progress."

cs-owen: sent interim email to customers who opened tickets. short note: we are rolling back a misapplied quota configuration and expect normal service soon.

infra-raj: logging CD pipeline fix: adding a manual approval gate for quota config promos and a label check to avoid canary->prod drift. will open PR.

devon: feature flag removal: undo enterprise bypass after stability check. `ff off bypass_quota_for_enterprise --env=prod` (holding for 10m observation).

incident-bot: Alert: P-2026-9001 mitigation: rollback + gate applied. Monitoring for 60 minutes.

maya: metrics now look back to baseline. latency normalized, error rate down to normal.

sre-lina: post-incident action items: 1) CD gating + label validation (infra), 2) add synthetic quota-check canary job to pre-prod and a sample prod canary, 3) adjust quota-client timeouts to fail-fast to avoid 504 fanout, 4) run tabletop for quota misconfig scenarios.

infra-raj: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/cd/pulls/501 - includes prod checkbox and label verifications.

product-olivia: schedule postmortem with SRE and product within next 48h. CS wants a customer-facing blurb after the tech write-up.

cs-owen: acknowledged; will prepare customer summary once postmortem draft ready.

maya: leaving incident open for 1 hour observation window. will close if no regressions.

incident-bot: P-2026-9001 status: mitigated at 17:05 UTC; watch until 18:05 UTC.

sre-lina: capturing quick root cause: mis-labeled canary config promoted to prod via CD -> aggressive quota applied -> quota-service returns 429 -> gateway experiences synchronous timeouts -> escalates to 502/504 for client requests.

devon: adding follow-up ticket for improved observability: link: https://tickets.internal/RED-3421 - spike correlation between 429->502s.

maya: good work team. after watch window, let's run through timeline and keep the postmortem short and action-oriented.

incident-bot: P-2026-9001 closed at 18:05 UTC (no regressions observed during watch).

maya: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
